about_the_game:
Caves of Combat is a fast-paced, ability-driven action roguelike where every run challenges you to master chaotic combat, discover game-breaking synergies, and confront the ancient force lurking below.

Beneath the surface lies a world twisted by time, filled with strange relics, hostile creatures, and a mysterious unrelenting force. You are not the first to descend — but you might be the last to survive.

Features

  • Fluid, responsive melee combat – Strike, maneuver, and survive in high-stakes close-quarters action.

  • Stackable abilities with wild synergies – Combine and scale your powers to take down tougher foes.

  • Challenging enemies and deadly boss fights – Face off against unique foes that test your skill and strategy.

  • Procedurally generated levels – Explore shifting, unpredictable layouts every time you descend.

  • Roguelike structure – Permanent death, fast runs, and the drive to go further with each attempt.

  • A hostile, mysterious world – The caves hold secrets, danger, and something watching from the dark…
